# Secondary page design direction

The production-approved homepage is the visual quality benchmark for the rest of the Black Bag Security site, but it is **not** a template to be copied page for page or section for section.

## What secondary pages should inherit

- executive confidence and buyer focus;
- concise copy before technical depth;
- graphic-first communication where a visual can replace explanatory text;
- restrained dark technical styling with cyan and green accents;
- strong hierarchy, deliberate spacing, and readable 100% zoom presentation;
- diagrams that communicate architecture, process, boundaries, evidence, or outcomes within seconds;
- evidence, confidentiality, rigor, and engineering depth as recurring themes;
- responsive layouts that remain composed rather than simply stacking oversized desktop components.

## What secondary pages should not do

- clone the homepage section order;
- reuse the same graphic composition simply because it exists on the homepage;
- force every page into the same left-copy / right-graphic arrangement;
- repeat homepage marketing claims when the page should provide specific service, methodology, trust, company, or engineering information;
- add decorative graphics that do not explain something useful;
- rely on large text walls where a diagram, process map, evidence object, comparison, or architecture view can communicate the point better.

## Page-specific interpretation

Each page should be designed around the decision it helps the visitor make.

Services should explain what can be engaged and why it matters. Methodology should show how work is controlled and trusted. Trust should demonstrate handling and confidentiality controls. About should establish institutional credibility. Contact should make engagement initiation simple. Arsenal should expose substantially deeper engineering detail than the homepage while remaining understandable and purposeful.

The target is family resemblance, not duplication: the site should clearly feel like one Black Bag Security system while each page has its own visual logic and reason to exist.
